description: Source code for Nordic Semiconductor's nPM6001 Watchdog driver implementation in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, configuration, and API functions for watchdog control via I2C.

methods.name: wdt_npm6001_setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the watchdog, currently a no-op.

methods.name: wdt_npm6001_disable
methods.description: Disables the watchdog by writing to specific registers over I2C.

methods.name: wdt_npm6001_install_timeout
methods.description: Configures the watchdog timeout period, arm, and trigger values.

methods.name: wdt_npm6001_feed
methods.description: Feeds (kicks) the watchdog to prevent timeout.

methods.name: wdt_npm6001_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog device, checks I2C bus readiness.
